contact_method: y < 0.14m and abs(vertical velocity) < 0.2m/s; heuristic only
cpu_scope: Gallery wrapper around Zombie physics/process callbacks, includes synchronous calls; excludes deferred engine/GPU work and other game systems. Render FPS affects calls/frame. Not mid-range certification.
limitations: Headless timing excludes GPU. Rest-pose heuristic does not prove zero T-poses or pops. Ragdolls are not exercised by horde mode. Preview bypasses gameplay transitions. No target-machine performance sign-off.
mocap_contact_method: Source toe contact intervals; actual rendered toe world displacement; excludes blends, transitions and track wraps
mocap_contact_timing_caveat: Use fixed-fps 60 for contact acceptance: unsynchronized render/physics clocks create sampling jitter, especially headless. Do not use fixed-fps runs for performance.
quality_acceptance: NOT CERTIFIED: mixed legacy/mocap library; full state and planted-contact runtime acceptance still required
validation_scope: Active population, missing resources/captures, sampled rest poses only. Not art or foot-contact acceptance.
